title: Ultrafast strong-field physics
summary: Exploring electron and nuclear dynamics in atoms and molecules on attosecond and femtosecond timescales. Topics include field-free molecular orientation, strong-field ionization and dissociation, intramolecular charge migration, and high-harmonic generation.

title: Quantum control theory
summary: Designing light fields for precise quantum manipulation under practical limits on bandwidth, pulse energy, and optical configurations. We develop theoretical and numerical methods for quantum-state preparation and control in the presence of environmental decoherence.

title: Quantum system identification
summary: Reconstructing quantum dynamics and physical parameters from limited, noisy measurements. Our approach combines physics-based models with machine learning to study ultrafast molecular processes and infer system evolution in complex environments.
